mapper.select: SELECT bbs32_comment_id AS comment_id , bbs32_person_id AS person_id , ( '<'||'b'||'>'|| f_emp_kor_nm(bbs32_person_id) ||' ('|| f_get_empTrans(bbs32_person_id, bbs32_reg_date::date, 'org_code_nm') ||' '|| f_get_empTrans(bbs32_person_id, bbs32_reg_date::date, 'pos_nm') ||') '|| '<'||'/b'||'>'|| TO_CHAR(bbs32_reg_date,'YY.MM.DD') ||' '|| bbs32_time ) AS comment_full_str , ( SELECT '파일('||COUNT(sys10_file_id)||')' FROM sys10_file WHERE sys10_parent_id = bbs32_comment_id ) AS file_str , ( CASE WHEN bbs32_person_id = #{personId} THEN '✕' ELSE '' END ) AS delete_str , '✕' AS delete_master_str , bbs32_comment AS comment FROM bbs32_comment WHERE bbs32_content_id = #{contentId} AND bbs32_company_id = #{companyId} ORDER BY bbs32_reg_date
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bbs32_comment (bbs32_comment_id, bbs32_company_id, bbs32_person_id, bbs32_content_id, bbs32_reg_date, bbs32_time, bbs32_comment) VALUES (#{commentId}, #{companyId}, #{personId}, #{contentId}, f_sysdate(), TO_CHAR(f_sysdate(), 'HH24:MI:SS'), #{comment})
